flags.why: The face-up sense is regional Central Vietnamese, as documented in the [Huế dialect dictionary](https://khungcuahep.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/T%E1%BB%AB-%C4%90i%E1%BB%83n-Ph%C6%B0%C6%A1ng-Ng%E1%BB%AF-Hu%E1%BA%BF-Tr%E1%BA%A7n-Ng%E1%BB%8Dc-B%E1%BA%A3o.pdf), and needs a regional warning.
The entry omits the common adjective meaning understanding of other people's feelings, recorded in [VDict](https://vdict.com/t%C3%A2m%20l%C3%AD%2C3%2C0%2C0.html).
flags.fix: adj | understanding; considerate (of other people's feelings) — ex: Cô ấy rất tâm lí. = She is very understanding.
